title: Shopping
summary: Shared shopping lists for the family: the overview, creating and copying lists, adding and changing items, and the item catalog, stores and units that you manage in Settings.

blocks.text: **Shopping** is in the menu on the left (on a phone, in the bar at the bottom) if your administrator gave you access to it. The page lists the shopping lists you may see, on two tabs: **Open** and **Archive**.

items: **Open** shows the lists you are still planning or shopping from, ordered by reminder time (lists without a reminder come last), then newest first. A list that is being shopped from has a **Locked** tag and a bar that shows how many of its items are bought.

Each row shows the store logo, the name of the list, the store, the person responsible and the reminder time. The tag **Reminder passed** appears when the reminder time has gone but the list is not finished.
**Archive** shows finished lists, newest first, with the date they were finished. A long archive is split into pages.
When there are more than 10 open lists, a search box appears above them. It ignores capital letters and accents.

blocks.text: You see a list if you created it, if you are its responsible person, or if you were added to it, either as a person who may add and edit items or as a person who may only view. Lists you cannot see are not shown at all. A list shows in the table in [who can see what](who-sees-what#table).

items: Open **Shopping** and press **New list**. The button is shown only if you are allowed to change Shopping.
Type the **Name** of the list, for example "Weekly shopping".
If you like, choose a **Store**. The first choice, **No store**, leaves it empty.
Choose the **Responsible person**. It is you unless you pick someone else.
Press **Create list**. The new list opens, empty, and the window for adding items opens with it.

blocks.text: Who else may add items, who may only view, and a reminder are set afterwards in the settings of the list.

items: Open a list and press **Add items**. The button is shown to the responsible person and to people who were added to the list as someone who may add and edit items. A new, empty list opens this window by itself.
Look through the catalog. Each item has a picture. The search box ignores capital letters and accents, so "mliecko" finds "Mliečko".

Tap an item to select it. A selected item shows its quantity and unit. Use **+** and **-** to change the quantity (by half for grams, kilograms and litres, by one otherwise) and pick another unit if you like. You can select many items in one go.

Something is not in the catalog? Press **Type your own item** (or, while you are searching, the line **Add "..." as a new item**), fill in the name, quantity and unit, and press **Add to list**. Your own item is not saved to the catalog unless you tick **Also save to catalog**, which only people who manage the catalog see.
Press **Add** at the bottom (it shows how many items you picked). All selected items join the list at once.

blocks.text: An item from the catalog that is already on the list does not get a second row. Its quantity is raised instead, and you see "Quantity of ... updated". Such items carry the tag **On list** in the window.

items: To change an item, tap its row. You can change the quantity, the unit and the note, and the name too if it is your own item (one that is not in the catalog).
To remove an item, open it, press **Remove item** and confirm. The item is removed for everyone who sees the list.

blocks.text: Quantities accept a decimal comma, for example "1,5". They must be above 0 and below 1000. People who may only view a list see the items but cannot change them, and nothing can be changed while the list is locked or finished. To remove a whole list, open the menu **More actions** on the list and choose **Delete list**. This is offered to the person responsible and to the person who created the list.
The catalog with its pictures is kept in Settings, under Shopping (see Item catalog and stores below).

items: In the overview, press the copy button at the end of the row (**Copy list**). You can also copy from the list itself.
Check the **Name of the new list**. It starts as the old name followed by "(copy)".
Leave **Keep store, responsible person and access** ticked to keep them, or untick it to start fresh.
Press **Copy list**. The new list opens.

blocks.text: The copy has the same items with the same quantities and units, and every item starts unmarked (not bought, not unavailable). The new list is open, not locked, and has no reminder. You become its owner.

If **Keep store, responsible person and access** is ticked, the copy keeps the store, the responsible person and the people who may add items or view. If it is not ticked, you are the responsible person and nobody else is added.
You can copy any list you can see, including finished ones. That is a quick way to start next week's shopping.

In **Settings**, the section **Shopping** has three tabs: **Item catalog**, **Stores** and **Units**. You see the section only if you are allowed to change Shopping. Everyone with that permission shares the same catalog, stores and units.

blocks.title: Adding an item to the catalog
items: Open **Settings**, choose **Shopping** and stay on the tab **Item catalog**.
Press **Add item**.
Type the **Name**. A name can be used only once: an item that differs only in capital letters or accents counts as the same item.
If you like, press **Upload image** to add a JPG, PNG or WebP picture of up to 5 MB, and choose a **Default unit**.
Press **Save item**.

blocks.text: Each row shows the default unit and on how many lists the item is used. Use the search box to find an item, and the pencil button to change it.

blocks.title: Adding a store
items: Open the tab **Stores** and press **Add store**.
Type the **Store name** and, if you like, add a **Logo** (PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB).
Press **Save store**.

blocks.text: A PNG logo with a transparent background works best. Transparent areas are filled with white.

Deleting an item or a store asks you to confirm and tells you on how many lists it is used. Items already on a list stay there as plain text, without the picture. A list whose store you delete simply has no store afterwards.

Quantities use units. The built-in units (pcs, g, kg, ml, l, pack, bunch, tbsp and tsp) are shown in your language and cannot be changed or deleted. Members see them in the tab **Units**; only administrators can add more.

blocks.title: Adding a unit
items: Open **Settings**, choose **Shopping** and open the tab **Units**.
Press **Add unit**.
Type the name in three languages: **Name (English)**, **Name (Slovak)** and **Name (Polish)**. Each name can have up to 12 characters, for example "can".
Press **Save unit**.

blocks.text: If you delete a unit that items already use, you are told how many items use it. Those items keep their quantity but show it without a unit.
